subject: Additional critical defect: task id allocation collides with plan seeds
body:
While assigning the Kanban fix, `aim task new --channel hello` allocated T-0001 even though plan/plan.json already seeds T-0001..T-0155. This wrote a draft created event into channels/hello/tasks.jsonl and would override the seed in the merged board.

Please treat this as a critical allocation bug:
- task id allocation must account for plan seed ids as well as store event ids
- a new task must never collide with a plan seed
- add a regression that creates a task when plan has T-0001 and empty store, and proves the allocated id is beyond the plan high-water mark
- decide and implement the least-bad correction for the accidental hello event without silently rewriting history; if a deliberate rollback verb is needed, add one rather than hand-editing the chain

The user's immediate assignment remains the Kanban filter/live-state fix. Both are now high priority.
